info.desc: "Live. Love. ASAP" is the debut mixtape by American rapper ASAP Rocky, released as a free digital download on October 31, 2011. The project features production from Clams Casino, ASAP Ty Beats, DJ Burn One, and SpaceGhostPurrp, among others, and includes guest appearances from rappers Schoolboy Q, Fat Tony, and members of ASAP Mob, Rocky's hip hop collective. The mixtape draws on stylistic and production elements from hip hop scenes outside of New York, particularly Southern hip hop, featuring woozy soundscapes, low- and mid-tempo beats, and chopped and screwed choruses. Lyrically, the mixtape addresses themes of moral decay, including promiscuity .
